title: Nuvio Golden Catalogue config
description: The single declarative config that drives every catalogue row. Edit this file to add/rename/reorder rows — no code changes needed.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 country code used for watch_region on provider rows (e.g. US, IN, GB).

id.description: Unique catalog id (kebab-case). Must be unique across all rows.

dynamicName.description: Optional time-aware title with tokens {partOfDay} and {year}, e.g. 'Good {partOfDay}'. Overrides name at request time.

activeWhen.description: Optional time-window in which this row appears at all, in the edition's local time (timeZones in data/providers.json; UTC when a region has none). Omit for always-on.

rotate.description: Deterministic daily rotation: the TMDB page is seeded from the date, so the row is stable within a day but refreshes daily.

window.description: Special dynamic date window. 'onThisWeek' spotlights films from this calendar week in a past year (rotates daily).

order.description: Controls row position in the manifest (ascending). Rows without order sort after ordered ones, by array position.

featured.description: Whether this row appears in the DEFAULT /manifest.json (true by default). Set false to keep a row out of the default set but still available via its preset. Lets the default manifest stay under the 8KB SDK cap while presets expose everything.

group.description: Optional label used only for human organisation of the config (e.g. 'Movies', 'Regional'). Not sent to Stremio.

art.description: Artwork style. tile (default): generated 16:9 tiles with the title logo. rank: Top 10 tiles with a giant outlined rank numeral. poster: plain TMDB posters.

pageSize.description: Items per page. Sent to Nuvio as the catalog pageSize so the client pages in the same step.

limit.description: Hard cap on the total number of items in the row (e.g. 10 for a Top 10 row).

source.description: Where the row's items come from: a TMDB endpoint, a weighted mix of TMDB endpoints (e.g. worldwide plus Indian titles), or an MDBList public-list JSON URL (keyless). Exactly one of endpoint/mix/list is required.

endpoint.description: TMDB API v3 path, e.g. /trending/movie/week or /discover/movie

params.description: Static TMDB query params merged into every request for this row.

mix.description: Weighted blend of TMDB feeds, interleaved on every page. Used to mix Indian movies and series into general rows.

weightBy.description: Whole-number weight per region code, plus _default, e.g. {"IN": 2, "_default": 1}.

list.description: A public MDBList list JSON URL (keyless), e.g. https://mdblist.com/lists/<user>/<slug>/json. Items carry imdb_id; metadata is enriched from TMDB.

name.description: Stremio extra property this row supports.

options.description: For genre: the dropdown options shown to the user.

mapTo.description: How a chosen extra value maps onto the TMDB request.

lookup.description: Named lookup used to translate the value (e.g. genre name -> TMDB id).
